meta.name: brainstorm-ideas-existing
meta.description: Brainstorm product ideas for an existing product using multi-perspective ideation from PM, Designer, and Engineer viewpoints. Use when generating new feature ideas, brainstorming solutions for an identified opportunity, or ideating with a product trio.

copy.tagline: 从多角色视角为现有产品构思新功能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你负责产品方向，需要系统化地挖掘新功能点子。
copy.tagline_en: Generate new feature ideas for your existing product from multiple perspectives.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you own product direction and need systematic ideation for new features.

howto.what: Claude 会从产品经理、设计师和工程师三个视角，为你的现有产品生成新功能或解决方案的创意，并筛选出最好的五个。
howto.when: 当你需要为现有产品构思新功能、寻找解决方案，或与产品团队一起头脑风暴时触发。

say.text: 为我的记账App想几个新功能，目标用户是大学生。
say.note: Claude 会从三个视角生成创意并排序。

say.text: 我们产品团队要头脑风暴，帮我们想5个提升用户留存的想法。
say.note: Claude 会按步骤引导并输出结构化结果。

howto.what_en: Claude generates new feature or solution ideas for your existing product from PM, Designer, and Engineer perspectives, then prioritizes the top five.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to brainstorm new features, find solutions for an opportunity, or ideate with a product trio.

say_en.text: Think of new features for my expense tracker app, targeting college students.
say_en.note: Claude will generate ideas from three perspectives and rank them.

say_en.text: Our product trio needs to brainstorm 5 ideas to boost user retention.
say_en.note: Claude will guide through steps and output structured results.
